body.name: Tail-band escape perturbation
body.construction: For \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm H}\), multiply \(\widehat\pi_{a,-k}(x)\) by \(1+M_n^{-(\gamma_a-1)}\) whenever \(\widehat\pi_{a,-k}(x)\le M_n/\widehat h_{a,n}\), leave it unchanged elsewhere, and reapply the same probability-range constraint. Call the result \(\widehat\pi^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,-k}\), and compute \(E^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,n}\) and \(D^{\mathrm{esc}}_{a,n}\) from that learner.
